web.github.title: GitHub App
web.github.intro: lastcall works through your own GitHub App. It can only read and change the repositories you install it on, and the pull requests it opens wait for your approval.
web.github.owner: GitHub account or organization that will own the App
web.github.confirm: GitHub will create a private App named {name} for {owner}, with these permissions: {permissions}. No webhooks: lastcall asks GitHub when it needs to.
web.github.bad_owner: That is not the name of a GitHub account or organization.
web.github.bad_state: This answer does not come from the page lastcall showed you. Start again.
web.github.failed: GitHub did not hand over the App: {error}
web.github.install_hint: Choose all your repositories or only some. You can change it at any time.
web.done.app_created: App created. Now install it on the repositories lastcall may work on.
web.accounts.id_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, such as claude-max.
web.accounts.reserve_label: Reserve for you, % of every week
web.accounts.bad: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes for the name, 40 at most.
web.accounts.exists: There is already an account with that name.
web.accounts.login: Sign it in with its own official login, in a terminal on this machine. lastcall never sees the login:
web.accounts.terms: Subscription plans are meant for each vendor's own tools. lastcall runs the official CLI and never handles your credentials. Read your provider's terms first.
web.accounts.no_sandbox: The sandbox is not available here. Start lastcall with docker compose to read quotas.
web.done.account_added: Account added. Sign it in, then read its quota.
web.done.reading: Reading the quota in the sandbox. Reload this page in a minute.
web.dest.title: Add a destination
web.dest.failed: The test did not get through, so the destination was not saved. Apprise says:
web.dest.test_failed: The test did not get through. Apprise says:
web.dest.required: Fill in every field that the service needs.
web.dest.bad_server: Write the server's address, such as https://ntfy.example.com.
web.dest.bad_smtp: Write the SMTP server's name, such as smtp.example.com.
web.dest.telegram.step1: In Telegram, open @BotFather, send it /newbot and follow its steps. At the end it gives you the bot's token.
web.dest.telegram.step2: Open your new bot and press Start, or send it any message.
web.dest.telegram.step3: Paste the token here and press Find my chat.
web.dest.telegram.chat_hint: Press Find my chat, or write the ID if you know it.
web.dest.telegram.none: Your bot has no recent messages. Send it any message in Telegram, then press Find my chat again.
web.dest.telegram.bad_token: Telegram does not accept that token. Copy it again from @BotFather.
web.dest.telegram.bad_chat: A chat ID is a number, such as 123456789, or a channel name, such as @mychannel.
web.dest.telegram.webhook: This bot uses a webhook, so lastcall cannot read its messages. Write the chat ID by hand.
web.dest.ntfy.step1: Install the ntfy app on your phone (Android or iOS), or open ntfy.sh in your browser.
web.dest.ntfy.step2: Subscribe to the topic below. It is random on purpose: anyone who knows a topic's name can read it.
web.dest.ntfy.server_hint: Leave it as it is, unless you run your own ntfy server.
web.dest.ntfy.bad_topic: A topic uses letters, digits, dashes and underscores, 64 at most.
web.dest.discord.step1: In Discord, open the channel's settings, then Integrations, then Webhooks.
web.dest.discord.step2: Create a webhook, press Copy Webhook URL and paste it here.
web.dest.discord.bad: That is not a Discord webhook URL. It starts with https://discord.com/api/webhooks/.
web.dest.slack.step1: In Slack, add an incoming webhook to the channel: create an app at api.slack.com/apps and turn on Incoming Webhooks.
web.dest.slack.step2: Copy the webhook URL and paste it here.
web.dest.slack.bad: That is not a Slack webhook URL. It starts with https://hooks.slack.com/services/.
web.dest.email.name: Email
web.dest.email.step1: Use the account that sends the email. With Gmail, turn on 2-Step Verification and create an app password, then use it instead of your password.
web.dest.email.to: Send to, if it is another address
web.dest.email.smtp: SMTP server, only if your provider is not Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo or a similar one
web.dest.email.bad: That is not an email address.
web.dest.apprise.name: Other (Apprise URL)
web.dest.apprise.step1: Paste the Apprise URL of any of the more than 100 services that Apprise reaches.
